Name: Asters Phonebox Catalogue for the Big Furniture Pack
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description[/u]
[list]
[*]Adds all the items I retexture in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240]Asters Big Furniture Pack[/url] to a single custom shop so they're easier to find[/*]
[*]A lot of my Alternative Textures mods tend to retexture the same items so it's useful to have this mod if you have trouble finding the furniture for any of my mods[/*]
[*]Optional retextures available so the shop doesn't look like a phonebox[/*]
[/list]
[u]Quick start instructions[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder. (If you are confused check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿﻿)﻿[/*]
[*]Download an Alternative Textures content pack, for example [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240]Asters Big Furniture Pack[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Buy the paint bucket and phonebox catalogue from Robin's Carpenter shop[/*]
[*]Put the furniture anywhere and then use the paint bucket tool on it to retexture it ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OzCzEppsXVY]video tutorial here[/url])[/*]
[/list]
[u]Config guide[/u]
[list]
[*]To get the different textures, like the mouse, launch the game until a config.json appears in the "[CP] Phonebox retexture" folder, and then choose Option 1 or Option 2[/*]
[*]If you download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ you can change it while playing the game[/*]
[/list]
[u]Tips and Tricks[/u]
[list]
[*]Not [i]everything[/i] listed in the shop is guaranteed to have retextures. I just listed furniture I normally retexture/plan to retexture[/*]
[/list][u]Mods that go well with this one[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240]Asters Big Furniture Pack[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984]AT tool retexture[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11158]Smart Buildings[/url]  - so you can place all furniture outdoors[/*]
[*]One tile high [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11781]buget TV[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12629]tree of the winter star[/url] so the item footprint is smaller and you can get those items right up against the wall[/*]
[/list]
